data.body: Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 1309 (stacked on 1310). Delivered per plan: (1) DET caused_by floor — epic_bug_floor_findings blocks an epic close exactly like an unclosed child when an open/in_progress bug records caused_by into the subtree; floor read errors withhold certification instead of blocking (mirrors child-closure read-error arm). (2) Candidate filter — open/in_progress bugs linked to the subtree (either direction, any relation) or created after the epic's first open->in_progress STATUS event (retired events included), ceiling 32 with overflow note. (3) Trivial-class single-turn screen (epic_bug_screen.py) mirroring the judge_one idiom, warm-then-fan-out (first sync, rest pool of 8); A-verdicts forwarded as compact block (cap 8 full rows + titles) inside the fenced context; per-candidate failure degrades to C; run_screen never raises. Verifier prompt gains the adjudication directive (block only defect-in-deliverable with NO disposition; reasoned prose or supersedes/duplicates link qualifies; bare 'out of scope' does not). Sidecar tally via emit_screen_tally. 33 unit tests (30 new + fixture widening in completion workflow tests); mypy clean; schema-coverage guards pass. NOTE: the live-calibration AC is operator-attested and remains for the operator after merge.
